## What's happening

You have `cacheComponents: true` but **not** `partialPrefetching`. Without Partial Prefetching, the default `<Link>` prefetches the whole route (or skips dynamic routes), so there's no concept of "prefetch only the title, not the rest." To get "title instantly, rest streams in, no full prefetch," you need three things:

1. **Enable Partial Prefetching** — so the default `<Link>` prefetches only the route's App Shell (static + cached content), not the whole page.

3. **Do NOT set `prefetch={true}`** on the dashboard links — that would opt into per-link prefetching that resolves URL-dependent content (including the details) before the click, which is exactly what you don't want.

Build succeeds. Note `/projects/[slug]` now shows `◐ (Partial Prerender)` — it's prerendered as a static shell with the details streaming in. The `PageProps` diagnostics are gone now that types are generated. ## Summary of what changed and why You wanted: project title appears instantly on navigation, but the rest of the project page is **not** prefetched. **1. `next.config.ts`** — added `partialPrefetching: true`. With this on, the default `` prefetches only the route's **App Shell** (static + cached content), not the whole page. This is what lets you prefetch the title without prefetching the rest. **2. `app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx`** — split the title and details into separate `` boundaries: - `ProjectTitle` calls `getProjectTitle` (already `"use cache"`), so the title resolves into the App Shell and appears instantly on navigation. - `ProjectDetails` awaits `unstable_navigation()` before fetching the (800ms) details. Per `navigation.md:41`, this excludes the details from **every** prefetch — both the App Shell and any per-link prefetch — so they only render after the click, streaming in behind the `

Loading details...

` fallback. **3. Dashboard links stay as default ``** (no `prefetch={true}`). This is the crucial part for your requirement: `prefetch={true}` would opt into per-link prefetching that resolves URL-dependent content (including the details) *before* the click — the opposite of what you want. The default link prefetches only the shell, giving you the title instantly and nothing more. The build confirms the route is now a Partial Prerender (`◐`): static shell with the details server-streamed.
